description: Changes one setting that holds for the whole site: the sender name, the sender address, the reply-to address, the email signature, the footer text, or one of the switches for footer branding, unsubscribe links and email verification. Take it when every mail from your site should carry something else. A host says: "My mails go out with the wrong sender name." It needs the session, the field and the value. This applies to every webinar on the site and to every email it sends, not only the one in this chat, so say that in one sentence before writing. It writes on your site. Only this fixed list is open; anything else is refused. For the colours of the emails see wi_change_site_colors. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: sender name, sender address, mail footer, unsubscribe link

field.description: Which setting to change. One per call.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

value.description: The new value. For a switch pass true or false, for the rest the text itself.

name: wi_change_site_settings
title: Change one WebinarIgnition setting of the whole site
